newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty fixed stronger at 2.50 pct from parity rate.
newsitem.headline: Zloty fixed stronger at 2.50 pct from parity rate.

text.p: The National Bank of Poland (NBP) fixed the zloty at 3.1395 to the dollar, up from 3.1480 on Thursday, and at 1.8280 to the mark, down from 1.8230, the central bank said.
The central bank fixed the zloty at an average of 2.50 percent from the weighted dollar and mark parity rates, stronger than Thursday's 2.47 percent fix.
The zloty was fixed at 2.51 percent from the floating parity rate, which changes in line with currency moves on world markets, against a 2.43 percent fix on Thursday.
